verdict.rationale: Status lookup is a fair question for a government tax service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no public-page tool for checking the status of a filing, application or case. The closest items are links to log into the authenticated professional and personal spaces, a 'Vérifier un avis d'impôt' tool (checking a tax notice's authenticity, not tracking a filing's status), and an FAQ on accessing CFE notices. These are adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
